text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: PD-48231 — service=inf-runtime, alert=high-p99-latency. P99 > 3x SLO threshold. Paging eng-oncall rotation now.
PagerDuty: Auto-page executed to rotation (current oncall: Maya R).
Maya R: acked. I'm grabbing the dashboards — tagging @Liam R for autoscaler insights.
Liam R: oncall here, looking. Any customer-facing errors or just latency?
Santiago: seeing increased tail latency for text-gen route /v1/generate, no 5xx spike (errors ~0.2%). Traffic looks normal but seq len distribution increased (more long-context requests).
Maya R: p95 ~ 420ms (baseline 80ms), p99 ~ 3.6s (baseline ~1.1s). Token throughput steady.
Maya R: running quick checks:
```bash
kubectl get hpa -n prod inf-runtime-hpa -o yaml
```
Maya R: HPA currently scaling based on cpu with minReplicas:6 maxReplicas:20, currentReplicas:7, targetCPUUtilizationPercentage:60.
Liam R: autoscaler saw a small oscillation earlier — scale from 6->9->7 in the last 5m. That can cause KV cache cold starts and hotpath thrash.
Santiago: sidecar redis eviction rate spiked: evicted_keys/s ~ 120 (baseline <5). Key TTL churn suggests cache warmup penalty.
Eva L: confirmed from sidecar logs: "evicting key due to memory pressure" repeated.
Maya R: suspect combined effect: a traffic subset with long contexts causing cache churn + HPA hysteresis -> p99 tail.
Maya R: quick mitigation plan: 1) raise minReplicas to 10 to stop downscale oscillation, 2) temporarily pin heavy-request routing to fallback model-quantized variant in eu-west, 3) increase Redis maxmemory for sidecars to reduce evictions.
Liam R: agree. I'll apply HPA patch now (non-disruptive):
```bash
kubectl patch hpa inf-runtime-hpa -n prod --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":10}}'
```
Liam R: done. Confirming replicas moving to 10.
Maya R: updating routing rule to fallback model for noisy route (canary): /v1/generate?route=tail-guard -> model=redwood-lite-v1.
Maya R: applied route override; traffic cutoff to heavy variant 30s ago.
Santiago: sidecar mem cap bump pushed (config map) and rolling restart for sidecars on -runtime pods starting.
oncall-bot: deploy bot: configmap/sidecar-cache updated, rolling restart queued 12 pods.
Maya R: monitoring metrics... p99 dropping from 3.6s -> 1.8s after HPA change and route fallback. p95 down to 220ms.
PagerDuty: PD-48231 status: acknowledged by Maya R.
Liam R: still seeing some 2-3s tails on a small shard (about 4% of requests). Could be cold KV regions. Initiating targeted warming job: send synthetic warmup requests to those shards.
Maya R: starting warmup script (background):
```bash
python infra/tools/warmup_targets.py --service inf-runtime --shards 12 --qps 50
```
Maya R: warmup running. Also disabling aggressive downscale policy in the autoscaler for 10 minutes.
Eva L: customer impact: looks like a latency bump to a subset of low-latency customers using realtime endpoints. No broad incident-wide 5xx, but several users may have degraded UX. Notifying CSMs.
Santiago: logs show one node with high GPU mem swap activity; moving a pod off that node.
Maya R: cordon + drain problematic node.
```bash
kubectl cordon ip-10-0-12-34
kubectl drain ip-10-0-12-34 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
Maya R: node drained, pods rescheduled. p99 dropping further to ~1.1s.
Liam R: good. Any PagerDuty escalations incoming?
PagerDuty: No automatic escalations. PD-48231 remains acknowledged.
Maya R: planning handoff in 20m to Liam (overnight rotation). I'll leave runbook notes here and update the incident marker.
Maya R: Notes for handoff: cause likely HPA oscillation + KV cache evictions amplified by long-context traffic. Mitigations applied: minReplicas raised to 10, route fallback to redwood-lite-v1 for noisy route, sidecar mem bump + rolling restarts, targeted warmup, cordoned node removed. Continue monitoring eviction rate and p99 for 30m.
Liam R: taking handoff in 20. I'll watch for further downscales and schedule a follow-up postmortem to tune HPA hysteresis and sidecar eviction thresholds.
Maya R: handing off now — oncall visible in PD until handoff complete.
Maya R: :white_check_mark: Handoff complete. Leaving post-incident tasks: 1) re-evaluate HPA policy (use custom prometheus metric for request-latency buffer), 2) investigate hotkey patterns in requests that cause eviction, 3) consider sticky cache buckets per shard.
Liam R: acked, will pick up and file a P1 follow-up.
oncall-bot: incident bot comment added: "PD-48231 mitigated, monitoring continues."
Maya R: closing chat window for active coordination — will add timeline to incident doc. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
